records.title: Exempt surplus land: locally owned land
records.description: Proposes to expand the definition of "exempt surplus land" to include surplus land owned by local agencies within designated improvement districts and identified disadvantaged communities.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: tribal cultural resources: mitigation measures.
records.description: Expands the definition of “tribal resources” under CEQA to include a site, feature, place, cultural landscape, sacred place, or object with cultural value to a CA American Tribe that is identified by the Native American Heritage Commission as a sacred place or is included in a local tribal register.

records.title: Housing development: density bonus: incentives or concessions: labor standards.
records.description: Modifies Density Bonus law by clarifying that certain reductions/modifications to development standards, zoning requirements, or designs that involve labor standards are excluded from the definition of "incentives or concessions" that a local govt must grant. This means that developers cannot request labor-related adjustments as part of the incentives offered under the Density Bonus Law.

records.description: Updates APR requirements on the disposal of surplus land for affordable housing, including details on the types of housing and construction labor standards. Modifies how to report on HE progress. Adjusts provisions on ministerial approval of certain housing developments, such as two units on a single lot or in areas zoned for office, retail, or parking, and the subdivision of parcels for urban lot splits.

records.title: Local government: omnibus bill.
records.description: Would revise definition of “exempt surplus land” to remove the reference to buyers and instead mean 2 or more adjacent or nonadjacent parcels combined for disposition to one or more persons or entities, as specified.
